# bindgen 0.73.2 compatibility backport

The upstream crate is preserved except for two manifest bounds: syn remains on major 2 and prettyplease on 0.2. Their public syntax-tree types must agree when formatting generated bindings. All Rust sources, default features, runtime support and package version are unchanged.

The inventories cover the 62 original package files. These HEPTA metadata files are additional. See HEPTA-PATCH-PROVENANCE.json for the registry checksum, exact upstream commits and preparation checks. Native results belong to the complete candidate qualification records.
